class.DUELIST.description: Strength and dexterity: melee, block and attack speed
class.DUELIST.name: Duelist
class.DUELIST.lore: A gladiator of the arena. A quick blade, a block and a thirst for blood.
class.DUELIST.style: Rapid sword strikes, shield block and life leech. Survives by keeping the pace.
class.DUELIST.pros:
Life leech
Block and attack speed
Flexible builds
class.DUELIST.cons:
Average defence against magic
Needs gear
class.MARAUDER.description: Strength: more life and physical damage
class.MARAUDER.name: Marauder
class.MARAUDER.lore: An exile who survived on stubbornness and a heavy axe. Stands in the thick of the foes and does not fall.
class.MARAUDER.style: Slow, heavy blows, plenty of life and armour, healing from damage dealt. Forgives mistakes.
class.MARAUDER.pros:
The most life
Armour and regeneration
An easy start
class.MARAUDER.cons:
Slow attacks
Next to no evasion
class.RANGER.name: Ranger
class.RANGER.lore: A tracker of the wilds. Strikes from afar and never lets herself be caught.
class.RANGER.style: Quick bow shots, high evasion and movement speed. Good at farming.
class.RANGER.pros:
Evasion and speed
Ranged combat
Fast farming
class.SCION.description: All-rounder: exactly twenty of each attribute and a way into any branch of the tree
class.SCION.name: Scion
class.SCION.lore: An heiress of a noble house. Can become anyone.
class.SCION.style: Even attributes and a way into any branch of the tree. Strong if you know what to build.
class.SCION.pros:
Access to the whole tree
Even attributes
Any archetype
class.SCION.cons:
No specialisation of her own
For experienced players
class.SHADOW.description: Dexterity and intelligence: criticals, evasion and chaos
class.SHADOW.name: Shadow
class.SHADOW.lore: A hired killer. Strikes first and vanishes.
class.SHADOW.style: Critical strikes, poison and chaos, evasion. Huge damage, little room for error.
class.SHADOW.pros:
The best crits
Poison and chaos
Evasion
class.TEMPLAR.description: Strength and intelligence: armour, energy shield and the elements
class.TEMPLAR.name: Templar
class.TEMPLAR.lore: A former inquisitor. A hammer in one hand, a prayer in the other.
class.TEMPLAR.style: A mix of attacks and spells, armour plus energy shield, healing. A reliable all-rounder.
class.TEMPLAR.pros:
Armour and energy shield
Healing
High resistances
class.TEMPLAR.cons:
Average damage
Slow to ramp up
class.WITCH.description: Intelligence: energy shield and the elements
class.WITCH.name: Witch
class.WITCH.lore: Exiled for forbidden magic. Burns, freezes and strikes with lightning.
class.WITCH.style: Elemental spells, energy shield instead of armour, plenty of mana. Strong but fragile.
class.WITCH.pros:
High spell damage
Energy shield
The most mana

map.C1_BRINE_CAVES.name: Brine Caves

map.C1_CHIEFTAINS_BARROW.name: Chieftain's Barrow
map.C1_CRYPT_OF_EXILES.description: The resting place of those who came here before you.
map.C1_CRYPT_OF_EXILES.name: Crypt of Exiles

map.C1_FALLEN_RUINS.description: A fallen fortress still held by its garrison.

map.C1_MISTY_FERRY.name: Misty Ferry
map.C1_OLD_OUTPOST.description: A border fort whose garrison still stands its watch.
map.C1_OLD_OUTPOST.name: Old Outpost
map.C1_ROTTING_MIRE.description: A bog where the dead do not lie still.
map.C1_ROTTING_MIRE.name: Rotting Mire

map.C1_SHIP_GRAVEYARD.name: Ship Graveyard

map.C1_SMUGGLERS_GROTTO.name: Smugglers' Grotto
map.C1_TIDAL_SHORE.description: Wet sand, broken hulls and those the sea would not let go.
map.C1_TIDAL_SHORE.name: Tidal Shore
map.C1_WHISPERING_WOOD.description: A forest where wolves and spiders hunt and the trees watch you pass.
map.C1_WHISPERING_WOOD.name: Whispering Wood

map.C1_WOLF_THICKET.name: Wolf Thicket
map.C2_ABYSSAL_STAIR.description: Steps hewn downward, toward whatever prays in the dark.
map.C2_ABYSSAL_STAIR.name: Abyssal Stair
map.C2_ASHEN_WASTES.description: A scorched plain under a smouldering sky.
map.C2_ASHEN_WASTES.name: Ashen Wastes
map.C2_CINDER_CITADEL.description: A fortress that burned years ago and never quite burned out.
map.C2_CINDER_CITADEL.name: Cinder Citadel
map.C2_CRYSTAL_MINES.description: Mines where the stone crackles with lightning.
map.C2_CRYSTAL_MINES.name: Crystal Mines
map.C2_DEEP_ADITS.description: Adits deeper than any chart, where the ore itself begins to move.
map.C2_DEEP_ADITS.name: Deep Adits
map.C2_DROWNED_TEMPLE.description: A sanctuary that sank beneath the waves with its priests.
map.C2_DROWNED_TEMPLE.name: Drowned Temple
map.C2_EMBER_FIELDS.description: Fields where the ash never cools and the hounds never sleep.
map.C2_EMBER_FIELDS.name: Ember Fields
map.C2_FOOTHILL_ROAD.description: An old road into the mountains where snow buries the hunters' tracks.
map.C2_FOOTHILL_ROAD.name: Foothill Road
map.C2_FROSTFANG_GLACIER.description: A tongue of ice beneath which sleeps a wyrm older than the ridge.
map.C2_FROSTFANG_GLACIER.name: Frostfang Glacier
map.C2_FROZEN_PASS.description: A mountain path where the cold kills faster than a blade.
map.C2_FROZEN_PASS.name: Frozen Pass
map.C2_GEODE_HOLLOW.description: A cave lined with crystals where something stirs within.
map.C2_GEODE_HOLLOW.name: Geode Hollow
map.C2_GLACIER_TOMBS.description: Ancient tombs frozen into the glacier along with their masters.
map.C2_GLACIER_TOMBS.name: Glacier Tombs
map.C2_MINERS_VILLAGE.description: A village at the mouth of the mines: the miners went deep and came back changed.
map.C2_MINERS_VILLAGE.name: Miners' Village
map.C2_OBSIDIAN_QUARRY.description: A quarry where black glass and monsters are hewn from cooled lava.
map.C2_OBSIDIAN_QUARRY.name: Obsidian Quarry
map.C2_SLAG_PITS.description: Pits of molten slag where something lives.
map.C2_SLAG_PITS.name: Slag Pits
map.C2_STORM_PEAK.description: A summit struck by lightning more often than the ground below.
map.C2_STORM_PEAK.name: Storm Peak
map.C2_SUNKEN_SHRINE.description: A mountain lake swallowed the shrine but could not silence its priests.
map.C2_SUNKEN_SHRINE.name: Sunken Shrine
map.C2_TROLL_CAVES.description: A lair of mountain trolls strewn with the bones of unlucky travellers.
map.C2_TROLL_CAVES.name: Troll Caves
map.C3_BURIED_CITY.description: Rooftops jut from the sand, and the streets beneath are still full of residents.
map.C3_BURIED_CITY.name: Buried City
map.C3_CARAVAN_ROAD.description: An old trade road where the sand buries wagons along with their drivers.
map.C3_CARAVAN_ROAD.name: Caravan Road
map.C3_DRY_RIVERBED.description: The bed of a river that sank underground, and the beasts that followed it.
map.C3_DRY_RIVERBED.name: Dry Riverbed
map.C3_EMBALMERS_HALL.description: Here the dead were prepared for eternity, and some preparations are unfinished.
map.C3_EMBALMERS_HALL.name: Embalmers' Hall
map.C3_GLASS_DESERT.description: Sand fused to glass by some ancient fire, cutting soles and blinding eyes.
map.C3_GLASS_DESERT.name: Glass Desert
map.C3_MIRAGE_VALE.description: Here you see what is not there, and miss what is.
map.C3_MIRAGE_VALE.name: Mirage Vale
map.C3_RAIDER_CAMP.description: Tents among the rocks where the spoils are shared and the knives honed for the next.
map.C3_RAIDER_CAMP.name: Raider Camp
map.C3_RED_GORGE.description: A narrow pass between scarlet cliffs where the echo carries footsteps long before the foe.
map.C3_RED_GORGE.name: Red Gorge
map.C3_SALT_FLATS.description: A white crust of salt to the horizon, and tracks that end in the middle of the plain.
map.C3_SALT_FLATS.name: Salt Flats
map.C3_SANDSTONE_ARCH.description: A stone bridge carved by the wind, walked only by the boldest.
map.C3_SANDSTONE_ARCH.name: Sandstone Arch
map.C3_SCORPION_NEST.description: The cracks in the rock rustle with a hundred legs the moment you draw near.
map.C3_SCORPION_NEST.name: Scorpion Nest
map.C3_SINGING_DUNES.description: The dunes hum in the wind, and in the hum are the voices of the lost.
map.C3_SINGING_DUNES.name: Singing Dunes
map.C3_STORM_MESA.description: A table mountain above which the sandstorm never rests for an hour.
map.C3_STORM_MESA.name: Storm Mesa
map.C3_SUN_KINGS_PYRAMID.description: Beneath the peak of the pyramid sleeps the one who ruled the sands, and his sleep is light.
map.C3_SUN_KINGS_PYRAMID.name: The Sun King's Pyramid
map.C3_SUN_TEMPLE.description: A golden temple where priests prayed to the sun until it answered.
map.C3_SUN_TEMPLE.name: Temple of the Sun
map.C3_TOMBS_OF_KINGS.description: The resting places of ancient kings, whose guards do not know the age has ended.
map.C3_TOMBS_OF_KINGS.name: Tombs of Kings
map.C3_VULTURE_ROOST.description: Ledges over the abyss where the birds wait for a traveller to slip.
map.C3_VULTURE_ROOST.name: Vulture Roost
map.C3_WITHERED_OASIS.description: The palms withered long ago, and the well water turned bitter as poison.
map.C3_WITHERED_OASIS.name: Withered Oasis
map.C4_AMBER_TUNNELS.description: Sticky corridors where those who came before you are frozen in amber.
map.C4_AMBER_TUNNELS.name: Amber Tunnels
map.C4_BROOD_CHAMBERS.description: Warm chambers where the hive's next generation ripens.
map.C4_BROOD_CHAMBERS.name: Brood Chambers
map.C4_FLOODED_THICKET.description: A forest waist-deep in water where every log might be a maw.
map.C4_FLOODED_THICKET.name: Flooded Thicket
map.C4_FUNGAL_LOWLANDS.description: Mushrooms taller than trees, and spores that take root in the lungs.
map.C4_FUNGAL_LOWLANDS.name: Fungal Lowlands
map.C4_GREAT_TREE.description: A tree whose crown could hold a city, and something lives in it.
map.C4_GREAT_TREE.name: The Great Tree
map.C4_HIVE_HEART.description: The core of the hive, where the queen commands thousands upon thousands.
map.C4_HIVE_HEART.name: Heart of the Hive
map.C4_JUNGLE_EDGE.description: A wall of leaves beyond which the path vanishes at the first step.
map.C4_JUNGLE_EDGE.name: Jungle's Edge
map.C4_LOST_EXPEDITION.description: Tents, journals and not a single soul, only tracks leading into the thicket.
map.C4_LOST_EXPEDITION.name: Lost Expedition Camp
map.C4_MANGROVE_DELTA.description: Roots rise from the water like ribs, and something breathes beneath them.
map.C4_MANGROVE_DELTA.name: Mangrove Delta
map.C4_MANTIS_GARDENS.description: Abandoned gardens where the mantises pray only to hunger.
map.C4_MANTIS_GARDENS.name: Mantis Gardens
map.C4_ORCHID_GLADE.description: The flowers smell so sweet that travellers fall asleep and never wake.
map.C4_ORCHID_GLADE.name: Orchid Glade
map.C4_OVERGROWN_ROAD.description: The paving of an empire that fell so long ago the forest forgot it.
map.C4_OVERGROWN_ROAD.name: Overgrown Road
map.C4_PANTHER_TRAIL.description: A game trail where the hunter swiftly becomes the prey.
map.C4_PANTHER_TRAIL.name: Panther Trail
map.C4_ROYAL_COMBS.description: Combs brimming with royal jelly, and guards who know no fear.
map.C4_ROYAL_COMBS.name: Royal Combs
map.C4_SERPENT_SHRINE.description: Stone serpents on the walls, and living ones at the altar's foot.
map.C4_SERPENT_SHRINE.name: Serpent Shrine
map.C4_STRANGLER_GROVE.description: Here the vines strangle more than trees.
map.C4_STRANGLER_GROVE.name: Strangler Grove
map.C4_WASP_HOLLOW.description: Paper nests the size of houses, and a drone that makes the ground shake.
map.C4_WASP_HOLLOW.name: Wasp Hollow
map.C4_WEEPING_CANOPY.description: The leaves drip without end, and it is not always rain.
map.C4_WEEPING_CANOPY.name: Weeping Canopy
map.C5_ASHFALL_VALLEY.description: Ash falls like snow, and whole villages lie buried beneath it.
map.C5_ASHFALL_VALLEY.name: Ashfall Valley
map.C5_BRIMSTONE_MINES.description: Mines where brimstone was dug until the brimstone began digging men.
map.C5_BRIMSTONE_MINES.name: Brimstone Mines
map.C5_BURNING_BARRACKS.description: The barracks have burned for a hundred years, and the soldiers never woke.
map.C5_BURNING_BARRACKS.name: Burning Barracks
map.C5_CALDERA_LAKE.description: A lake of boiling water in the bowl of a volcano that is dormant, for now.
map.C5_CALDERA_LAKE.name: Caldera Lake
map.C5_CINDER_WASTES.description: The land is burned black, but something upon it still smoulders and moves.
map.C5_CINDER_WASTES.name: Cinder Wastes
map.C5_DRAGONS_VENT.description: A vent spewing flame that seems almost like breath.
map.C5_DRAGONS_VENT.name: Dragon's Vent
map.C5_FLAME_CITADEL.description: A stronghold where a throne of cooled lava was raised, and fire itself was seated upon it.
map.C5_FLAME_CITADEL.name: Citadel of Flame
map.C5_FRONTIER_FORT.description: The last bulwark before the fire, and its garrison long since changed sides.
map.C5_FRONTIER_FORT.name: Frontier Fort
map.C5_INFERNAL_GATE.description: The citadel gates, beyond which rings the laughter of those who called the fire.
map.C5_INFERNAL_GATE.name: Infernal Gate
map.C5_LAVA_FIELDS.description: A black crust over a river of fire that cracks with every step.
map.C5_LAVA_FIELDS.name: Lava Fields
map.C5_MAGMA_RIVER.description: A river of molten stone, and a ferryman who takes his fare in blood.
map.C5_MAGMA_RIVER.name: Magma River
map.C5_MOLTEN_CORE.description: The mountain's heart, where the stone flows and the air burns.
map.C5_MOLTEN_CORE.name: Molten Core
map.C5_OBSIDIAN_SPIRES.description: Needles of black glass taller than towers, each reflecting the flame.
map.C5_OBSIDIAN_SPIRES.name: Obsidian Spires
map.C5_OUTER_WALLS.description: The citadel's walls, blackened by fire, yet never fallen.
map.C5_OUTER_WALLS.name: Outer Walls
map.C5_SCORCHED_FOOTHILLS.description: Slopes split with cracks that weep smoke and heat.
map.C5_SCORCHED_FOOTHILLS.name: Scorched Foothills
map.C5_SIEGE_CAMP.description: The camp of an army besieging the citadel so long it has forgotten why.
map.C5_SIEGE_CAMP.name: Siege Camp
map.C5_SMELTERY.description: The furnaces here have not gone out in centuries, and they are not fed with coal.
map.C5_SMELTERY.name: The Smeltery
map.C5_WAR_FORGES.description: Forges where the citadel's weapons are made from what remains of its foes.
map.C5_WAR_FORGES.name: War Forges
map.C6_ABYSSAL_THRONE.description: At the bottom of all things, in a darkness without end, sits the one the abyss itself worships.
map.C6_ABYSSAL_THRONE.name: Throne of the Abyss
map.C6_BLIGHTED_FIELDS.description: The harvest rotted where it stood, and the rot moved on, into people.
map.C6_BLIGHTED_FIELDS.name: Blighted Fields
map.C6_CATACOMB_MAW.description: The catacombs lead down and down until they end in someone's throat.
map.C6_CATACOMB_MAW.name: Catacomb Maw
map.C6_ECLIPSE_ALTAR.description: An altar where the sun goes dark each time blood is spilled.
map.C6_ECLIPSE_ALTAR.name: Eclipse Altar
map.C6_ENDLESS_STAIR.description: The steps lead down further than the living can descend.
map.C6_ENDLESS_STAIR.name: Endless Stair
map.C6_FALLEN_STAR.description: A crater where something fell that shone, but was never a star.
map.C6_FALLEN_STAR.name: Fallen Star
map.C6_FORSAKEN_ABBEY.description: The monks prayed the abyss would not notice them. It did.
map.C6_FORSAKEN_ABBEY.name: Forsaken Abbey
map.C6_OSSUARY.description: The walls are built of bones, and some bones still remember who they were.
map.C6_OSSUARY.name: The Ossuary
map.C6_PLAGUE_VILLAGE.description: The houses are boarded up from inside, yet the knocking comes from without.
map.C6_PLAGUE_VILLAGE.name: Plague Village
map.C6_RIFT_EDGE.description: The land breaks off into the void, and the void looks back.
map.C6_RIFT_EDGE.name: Rift's Edge
map.C6_ROTTEN_HEART.description: The whole plague grows from a single place, and it beats.
map.C6_ROTTEN_HEART.name: The Rotten Heart
map.C6_ROTTING_ORCHARD.description: The apples fall and burst, and it is not worms that crawl out.
map.C6_ROTTING_ORCHARD.name: Rotting Orchard
map.C6_SPORE_CATHEDRAL.description: A cathedral overgrown with mycelium, where the choir sings in spores.
map.C6_SPORE_CATHEDRAL.name: Spore Cathedral
map.C6_STARLESS_DEEP.description: A darkness so thick the torchlight sticks in it like pitch.
map.C6_STARLESS_DEEP.name: Starless Deep
map.C6_VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.description: The thin line between the world and the abyss, worn through to holes.
map.C6_VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.name: Veil of Shadows
map.C6_VOID_SHORE.description: The surf here is black and silent, and it carries away more than sand.
map.C6_VOID_SHORE.name: Void Shore
map.C6_WHISPERING_CHASM.description: Whispers rise from the depths, and they know your name.
map.C6_WHISPERING_CHASM.name: Whispering Chasm
map.C6_WITHERED_WOOD.description: Leafless trees reach toward the traveller as if begging for help.
map.C6_WITHERED_WOOD.name: Withered Wood

enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_STRENGTH: Core attribute. Every 2 Strength grants +1 Life and every 5 grants 1% increased Physical Damage; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AGILITY: Core attribute. Each point of Dexterity grants +1 Evasion Rating; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_INTELLECT: Core attribute. Every 2 Intelligence grants +1 Mana and every 5 grants 1% increased Energy Shield; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CONSTITUTIO: Attribute of the hero's toughness: reflects bodily resilience and counts toward item requirements and special item properties.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_HEALTH: Maximum Life. When Life reaches zero, the hero dies.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA: Maximum Mana, the resource spent to use skills. Auras reserve part of it.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ENERGY: The hero's Energy pool, an extra resource spent and restored by certain skills and effects.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ENERGY_SHIE: A barrier over Life that absorbs hit damage first and recharges over time. Chaos Damage bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ARMOR: Reduces physical damage taken from hits. Works best against small hits; reduction is capped at 75%, and Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_EVASION: Grants a chance to fully evade attacks. Higher-level enemies need more Evasion to dodge; the chance is capped at 50%, and Maximum Evasion raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLOCK_CHANC: Chance to block a hit and take no damage from it. Capped at 50%; Maximum Block raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_STUN_THRESH: Raises the stun threshold: a hit must deal more damage to stun you.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SPELL_BLOCK: Chance to block spell damage. A retired stat that no longer affects combat.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_RE: Percentage by which all physical damage taken is reduced, on top of Armour. Capped at 75%; Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AVOID_STUN: Chance to avoid being stunned by a hit that would otherwise stun you.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_FIRE: Reduces Fire Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Fire Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_COLD: Reduces Cold Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Cold Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_LIGH: Reduces Lightning Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Lightning Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_CHAO: Reduces Chaos Damage taken, including poison. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Chaos Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_ALL: Adds to Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_: Raises the Fire Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Cold Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Lightning Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Chaos Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance caps above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLOCK_MAX: Raises the Block chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_EVASION_MAX: Raises the Evasion chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_RE: Raises the cap on physical damage reduction from Armour and reduction above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MA: Raises the Critical Strike chance cap above the base 70%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_PHYS: Physical damage of the hero's attacks. Reduced by the target's Armour and physical damage reduction.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_MAGI: Base damage of the hero's spells, scaled by skill and spell damage bonuses.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_FIRE: Fire Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Fire Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_COLD: Cold Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Cold Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_LIGH: Lightning Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Lightning Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_CHAO: Chaos Damage added to hits. Reduced by Chaos Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DAMAGE: A general multiplier to all damage the hero deals.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SKILL_DAMAG: Increases damage dealt by the hero's skills.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SPELL_DAMAG: Increases damage of spells and their damage over time effects.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DOT_TAKEN: Modifies damage over time taken, such as from burning, poison and bleeding.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_CH: Chance to land a critical strike for extra damage. Base 5%, capped at 70%; Maximum Critical Chance raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_DA: Adds to the damage multiplier of critical strikes.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MU: How much stronger a critical strike is than a normal hit. Base 150%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_VA: Share of critical strike damage returned to the hero as Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_TA: Increases the damage the target takes from critical strikes.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_F: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_C: Your damage ignores part of the target's Cold Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_L: Your damage ignores part of the target's Lightning Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_C: Your damage ignores part of the target's Chaos Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_E: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_A: Increases damage against enemies affected by any ailment, such as ignite, shock or poison.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_SPEE: How many attacks per second the hero makes. More attacks mean more damage per second.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CAST_SPEED: Speeds up spellcasting, making spells recover faster.
